instruction.text: Decide whether the following statements are true or false.

atoms.a: If you are touching water that is conducting electricity, you will be electrocuted.
It is safe to use electrical appliances around water.

instruction.text: Ravi is drying his hair and leaves the hair dryer in the bathroom. Find the hair dryer in the image.

atoms.a: Did Ravi leave the hair dryer in a safe place?
Why could leaving the hair dryer here cause someone to be electrocuted?
b: ++It could fall into the bath and get wet.
It could fall onto the floor and shoot electricity.

atoms.a: Where should Ravi have put it instead?

instruction.text: Find the electrical appliance that is in a dangerous place.

atoms.a: Why is the microwave in a dangerous place?
b: It is too high off the ground and might fall.
++It is too close to the sink and is at risk of getting wet.

instruction.text: Find the electrical appliance in the image.

atoms.a: Brendan washes their hands before making some toast. After washing their hands, they plug the toaster in without drying their hands first. Is this safe?
b: ++No, they should dry their hands thoroughly before using the toaster.

atoms.a: What could happen to Brendan if they use the toaster with wet hands?
